top_choice_rationale: P001 most strongly joins a defined GLP-1 physiological discovery to exceptionally mature, broad therapeutic benefit in diabetes and obesity. Its attribution is defensible when the citation remains confined to the enabling physiological and biological account rather than the full pharmaceutical-development enterprise.
